units: <cite ref="Shabbat 9b:4">Ib.</cite> <he>ת׳ בן אלעשה</he> the hair-cutting of the style of Ben Elashah (clipping); <cite ref="Nedarim 51a:7">Ned. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>והיינו ת׳ של וכ׳</he> and that is the style of the high priest’s hair-cutting; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 22b:22">Snh. 22ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="L00282"><he>לוּלְיָינִית</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 14b:21">M. Kat. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>אבל אסור בת׳</he> a mourner is forbidden to have his hair cut; a. e.
<cite ref="Beitzah 34a:4-10">Bets. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>אין … בת׳ שלו</he> you must not trim vegetables (on the Holy Day) with the shears with which they are cut in the garden.
